general.description: This Gahm Garri outpost in the Aleth Dep'Ai system maintains a fragile status quo, caught in the crossfire between space pirates and the Arythem Ships Police forces. As the system is considered as crucial in the ghost ships escape routes, the Gham Garri from Erathen Arn keeps supporting the outpost, which allows it to keep its ground and even thrive.
general.bar: Overproud Rithai Gham-warriors constantly in alert, briefly pausing between two flights.
